Peptides—short chains of amino acids—are `used as supportive treatments for hair thinning and shedding, most commonly via topical serums` . No peptide is FDA-approved to treat or reverse hair loss on its own.[[1]](https://plasticsurgerykey.com/best-peptides-for-hair-growth-ranked-by-hair-specific-evidence/)[[2]](https://omiwellbeauty.com/blogs/hair/can-peptides-really-help-your-hair-grow)[[3]](https://peptidepedia.org/guides/best-peptides-for-hair-growth)

### Top Peptides Used for Hair

- **Copper Peptides (GHK-Cu):** The most researched option, consisting of glycine, histidine, and lysine bound to copper. It increases vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) to improve blood supply and reduces scalp inflammation.[[1]](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13113319/)[[2]](https://www.ikclinics.co.uk/peptide-therapy/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/62U6lCUmcU0)[[4]](https://plasticsurgerykey.com/best-peptides-for-hair-growth-ranked-by-hair-specific-evidence/)[[5]](https://driphydration.com/blog/best-peptide-for-hair-loss/)[[6]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S_6OWFKA2H0&t=21)
- **Biomimetic Peptides (e.g., Acetyl Tetrapeptide-3, Biotinoyl Tripeptide-1):** Focus on anchoring the hair fiber, reducing shedding, and lengthening the active (*anagen* ) growth phase.[[1]](https://www.hims.com/blog/peptides-for-hair-growth)[[2]](https://omiwellbeauty.com/blogs/hair/can-peptides-really-help-your-hair-grow)
- **Growth Hormone / Secretagogues (e.g., Ipamorelin + CJC-1295):** Used off-label via injection to raise systemic IGF-1 levels, which indirectly support follicle cycling.[[1]](https://peptidepedia.org/guides/best-peptides-for-hair-growth)
- **Tissue Repair Peptides (e.g., BPC-157):** Sometimes used for local anti-inflammatory and vascular effects, though clinical data for hair regrowth is limited.[[1]](https://driphydration.com/blog/best-peptide-for-hair-loss/)[[2]](https://goldenbergdermatology.com/hair-loss/stem-cell-peptide-hair-loss-treatment-nyc/)[[3]](https://www.ikclinics.co.uk/peptide-therapy/)



---

### How They Work

- **Improve Circulation:** Stimulate microvascular blood flow around the follicle root.
- **Support Extracellular Matrix:** Encourage collagen and protein synthesis to strengthen the scalp and hair shaft.
- **Extend Growth Phase:** Help keep hair in the active growth stage longer rather than dropping prematurely.[[1]](https://omiwellbeauty.com/blogs/hair/can-peptides-really-help-your-hair-grow)[[2]](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13113319/)[[3]](https://www.hims.com/blog/peptides-for-hair-growth)[[4]](https://peptidepedia.org/guides/best-peptides-for-hair-growth)



---

### Important Expectations & Limits

- **Not a Replacement for Proven Drugs:** Peptides **do not** block DHT (dihydrotestosterone), meaning they cannot replace primary treatments like [minoxidil](https://www.hims.com/blog/peptides-for-hair-growth) or finasteride for pattern baldness.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Juw69Q5YJqI&t=49)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S_6OWFKA2H0&t=21)[[3]](https://peptidepedia.org/guides/best-peptides-for-hair-growth)
- **Timeline:** Visible improvements in hair quality, density, or reduced shedding typically require **3 to 6 months** of consistent use.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S_6OWFKA2H0&t=21)[[2]](https://peptidepedia.org/guides/best-peptides-for-hair-growth)
- **Delivery Methods:** Most common as over-the-counter leave-in scalp serums (0.5% to 2% concentration), sometimes paired with microneedling, shampoos, or off-label injections.[[1]](https://www.hims.com/blog/peptides-for-hair-growth)[[2]](https://peptidepedia.org/guides/best-peptides-for-hair-growth)

If you'd like to narrow this down, let me know:

- What **type of hair loss or thinning** you are experiencing (e.g., general shedding, receding hairline, pattern thinning)
- Whether you are already using treatments like **minoxidil or finasteride** 

I can help you figure out how peptides might fit into your routine.
